slideScriptures.text_en:

verses.text: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

verses.text_es: Y tardándose el esposo, cabecearon todas y se durmieron.

verses.text: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

verses.text_es: Y a la medianoche se oyó un clamor: ¡Aquí viene el esposo; salid a recibirle!

verses.text: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

verses.text: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

verses.text: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
verses.text_en: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
verses.text_es: Mas las prudentes respondieron diciendo: Para que no nos falte a nosotras y a vosotras, id más bien a los que venden, y comprad para vosotras mismas.
verses.copyright: Reina-Valera 1960 ® © Sociedades Bíblicas en América Latina, 1960. Renovado © Sociedades Bíblicas Unidas, 1988.

verses.text: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

verses.text: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

verses.text: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
verses.text_en: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
verses.text_es: Velad, pues, porque no sabéis el día ni la hora en que el Hijo del Hombre ha de venir.

verses.text: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

verses.text_es: Ninguno que milita se enreda en los negocios de la vida, a fin de agradar a aquel que lo tomó por soldado.

verses.text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
